cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Please put 'roof repaired by Pat' in the village minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We all know you fixed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The minutes weren't there with a ladder. They need telling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll thank you at the party.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the roof line, write 'thanks pending' so we remember.
